subject: Subprocessor delegation clarity and action plan for Acme Edge logging vendor
messages:
From: Emily Torres <contracts@acme-edge.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.example, lauren_bishop@redwood.example, monica_patel@redwood.example
Cc: security@acme-edge.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Subprocessor change notice — Observify (logging analytics) onboarding

Hi Sean / Lauren / Monica,

Hope you're well. We're preparing to onboard Observify (logs-vendor@observify.io) as a downstream subprocessor to handle indexed logs and real-time analytics for our edge product. Per Section 7.3 of our MSA and the data processing terms in the order form, we wanted to provide the formal change notice and surface the materials we have so you can confirm the flow-down and any DPA annex requirements.

Attached: AcmeEdge_Observify_Questionnaire_v1.pdf and our proposed OF redline (OF_redline_observify_track_changes.docx). High level:
- Subprocessor role: structured logs ingestion, enrichment, retention up to 90 days, ephemeral analytics caches for operational traces.
- Data: redacted customer identifiers, request URIs, status codes, and application logs. No full PII payloads expected, but some identifiers may be present.
- Hosting: multi-tenant cloud with EU region support (primary us-east for our customers).

We need:
1) Redwood to confirm whether the proposed order-form redline and DPA addendum are acceptable or whether you require additional flow-downs (encryption, sub-subcontractor notice, audit rights).
2) A list of evidence you require (SOC 2 type II, encryption-at-rest confirmation, Data Flow diagram).
3) A target timeline for review and sign-off — we are aiming to onboard Observify by Sep 1 if feasible.

Can you confirm next steps and who on your side will coordinate?

Thanks,
Emily Torres
Contracts Manager | Acme Edge

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.example
To: Emily Torres <contracts@acme-edge.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.example, monica_patel@redwood.example
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Subprocessor change notice — Observify (logging analytics) onboarding

Emily — thanks for the notice and the attachments. Quick read-through below and proposed plan.

Summary of what we'll need from Acme to process this through Legal + Security:
- Current SOC 2 Type II report (most recent 12 months) for Observify or their hosting provider.
- Data flow diagram showing where logs are parsed, retained, and where any linking/PII enrichment happens.
- Confirmation that Observify will persist no customer secrets (no full credit card or auth tokens) and that identifiers are hashed/internally pseudonymized where possible.
- Clarify whether Observify will act as a subprocessor to Redwood directly (i.e., will Redwood receive logs before/after processing) or only to Acme.

Internal owners + timelines:
- Legal (Lauren) to review the OF_redline and draft a one-page DPA addendum for subprocessor consent (target 5 business days).
- Security (Monica) to triage the questionnaire and request additional evidence if required (target 7 business days).
- I'll coordinate with Product/Eng if there is any operational impact that requires a change to retention or APIs.

Proposed gating conditions for us to provide conditional consent (subject to evidence & redlines):
1) Encryption at rest + TLS in transit for log streams.
2) Contractual audit rights (annual, with 30 days' notice) or a shared SOC 2 report.
3) Sub-subprocessor list and flow-down commitments for any downstream analytics providers.

Target: we can aim to return an internal sign-off or list of redlines by Aug 18, which should allow you to keep the Sep 1 target if Observify can provide SOC2 and the flow diagram this week. If any of the evidence is delayed, we'll need to push the timeline.

I'll hand to Lauren and Monica after they confirm availability.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
redwood.example

>

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.example
To: Emily Torres <contracts@acme-edge.com>, sean_gallagher@redwood.example
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.example
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Subprocessor change notice — Observify (logging analytics) onboarding

Emily / Sean — I reviewed the OF redline. I can expedite legal review but want to preempt two quick items we will push as change points: 

1) Subcontracting clause: we will request explicit flow-down for obligations relating to encryption, data deletion on termination, and prohibition on export of customer data outside agreed regions without prior written consent. Proposed snippet: "Vendor shall ensure that any subprocessor engaged to process Customer Data maintains equivalent technical and contractual controls, including encryption-at-rest, role-based access controls, and data deletion obligations that mirror those in this Agreement."

2) Mapping the retention period: the order form's 90-day retention needs to be explicit that logs older than retention are deleted and not archived for analytics unless otherwise approved by Customer. We'll request an audit clause specific to log retention.

Attached is a small redline snippet for the OF (see OF_redline_observify_track_changes.docx) — please confirm if Observify can accept the two bullets above. If so, Legal will prepare a short DPA addendum (subproc addendum) for signature.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

On Tue, Aug 11, 2026 at 09:06 AM sean_gallagher@redwood.example wrote:
> Emily — thanks for the notice and the attachments...

From: monica_patel@redwood.example
To: Emily Torres <contracts@acme-edge.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.example, sean_gallagher@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Subprocessor change notice — Observify (logging analytics) onboarding

Emily — thanks for your patience while we reviewed. We can provide conditional consent to Observify being added as a subprocessor subject to the following items being completed and documented: 

1) Observify provides their latest SOC 2 Type II report within five business days OR allows Redwood (or an agreed third-party assessor) to verify controls via an executed non-disclosure / assessor access arrangement.
2) Confirmed encryption-at-rest for all persisted logs and TLS 1.2+ in transit.
3) A finalized list of sub-subprocessors and a written commitment to flow down the same data protection obligations.
4) A clarified retention appendix: logs > 90 days must be purged unless Customer-approved archival is documented in the order form.
5) Observify agrees to limited audit rights (annual, reasonable notice) and to provide a contact for security incidents.

We have prepared a short addendum and a redlined order-form excerpt for signature: Subproc_Addendum_AcmeEdge_signed.docx (attached). Please have Observify confirm acceptance of the three bullets above and countersign the addendum. We can execute the addendum via DocuSign (link below) once we receive the SOC 2 or assessor access.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/relink/ABC123-ACME-OBS

If all items are provided by Aug 20, we will sign and complete onboarding by Aug 26 to help you meet your production timeline. If any evidence is delayed beyond Aug 20, please advise and we'll re-evaluate timing.

Best,
Monica Patel
Security Operations | Redwood Inference
